Genetic researcher |family =[[Cassandra Hawthorne]] - wife {{Icon|dead}} |TV actor =[[Eric Berryman]] }} {{Quotation|I want to reiterate that a society governed by scientists really is the ideal social structure!}} '''Lloyd Hawthorne''' was a leader of [[Hawthorne Medical Laboratories]], as well as the first [[overseer]] of [[Vault 4]] in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== He was a [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] scientist, later overseer, specializing in the effects of radiation on human DNA. He, his family, and eighty volunteers participated in a five-year-long trial run of Vault 4 before the [[Great War]]. After the war, he and his wife [[Cassandra Hawthorne|Cassandra]] took shelter in Vault 4, where he served as Overseer of the Vault and conducted cruel human experiments, including hybridizing humans with radiation-resistant animals and creating [[Gulper (TV series)|gulpers]].
